author: pi (native WSL, volcengine-plan/glm-5-3-flash)
review_gate: Codex must approve this plan before any diagnostic script executes

snapshots.data: grok.build_dataset(); grok.fixed_split(0.30); full enumeration, no subsets

hypotheses.name: float32 forward/backward loses small task gradients after memorization on saved values, seed-0-discriminatingly
hypotheses.observable_prediction: At seed0 memorization and/or final snapshots, float32 autodiff of the full-batch train loss differs materially from float64 autodiff on the identical loaded parameter values and identical batch (whole or block relL2 > 1e-3, or cosine < 0.999, or float32-zeroed coordinates), while seed0 init and every snapshot of seeds 1-4 stay below those thresholds.
hypotheses.falsifying_observation: No material defect at seed0 memorization/final, or defects of equal magnitude present in seeds 1-4 (non-discriminating).

metric_definitions.relL2: ||g32-g64||_2 / max(||g64||_2, floor); g64_degenerate flagged when ||g64||_2 < floor
metric_definitions.cosine: <g32,g64> / (||g32||_2 * max(||g64||_2, floor)); null when either norm < floor; never coerced
metric_definitions.nonfinite32_64: counts of NaN/Inf in each pass
metric_definitions.granularity: per leaf tensor, per block (embedding={emb,pos}, attention={wq,bq,wk,bk,wv,bv,wo,bo}, mlp={mlp1,mlp2}, head={head}), whole flattened gradient
metric_definitions.dtype_and_flag_logging: x64 flag and array dtypes recorded for both passes

decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.material_defect: whole relL2 > 1e-3 OR any block relL2 > 1e-3 OR cosine < 0.999 (when defined) OR zero_loss_count > 0 with ||g64||_2 >= floor
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h1_supported_engineering_level: material defect at seed0 mem and/or final AND none at seed0 init AND none at any seeds 1-4 snapshot
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h1_rejected: no material defect at seed0 mem/final OR defects equal across seeds (reported as non-discriminating)
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.threshold_justification: float32 unit roundoff 1.19e-7; benign accumulation over 62.5k coords expected relL2 <= 1e-5; threshold is 100x above
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.invalidation: positive control failure invalidates the diagnostic; all values retained; no in-session threshold retuning

hypotheses.baseline_tie_in: float32 recomputed train loss at each snapshot matches the run's logged train_loss (last log row) to relative 1e-5 (diag06 precedent: exact reproduction); mismatch aborts as harness defect
hypotheses.negative_anchor: init snapshots (large gradients) must show negligible relL2
hypotheses.positive_control: bfloat16 quantization of a transient copy of one grokked seed's final params must be flagged (relL2 > 0.01 vs float64 on identical values); official model untouched
hypotheses.precision_context: x64 disabled at import; float32 pass first; then jax.config.update('jax_enable_x64', True) verified by dtype assertions; weights only loaded and explicitly cast, init_params never called; if runtime toggle fails the script aborts with a failure record (no silent fallback)
hypotheses.allowed_conclusion: whether float32 autodiff materially distorts loss/gradient on the saved weights and whether it is seed-0-specific
hypotheses.not_supported_conclusion: that float32 precision caused seed0's non-grokking within 10000 steps; anything about steps > 10000; any model change

hypotheses.name: attention saturates or uses a positional/order-dependent shortcut restricting modular structure learning
hypotheses.observable_prediction: Seed0's answer-row (position 2) attention at final (and directionally at memorization) shows either (H2a) markedly lower mean entropy than every grokked seed with sat_frac > 0.5 while every grokked seed < 0.1, or (H2b) near-zero input dependence (input_dep_std < 1e-4 vs grokked > 1e-4), or large one-variable intervention effects (I1 pos->0 |dAcc| > 0.5 vs grokked < 0.1; I2 swap a,b acc drop > 0.5 vs grokked < 0.1).
hypotheses.falsifying_observation: Seed0's attention metrics and intervention deltas all lie within the [min, max] span of seeds 1-4 at the same checkpoints.

metric_definitions.scope: per snapshot, per head (4), frozen grok.attention_weights, all 9409 pairs
metric_definitions.entropy: H = -sum_j w_j ln w_j over the 3 causal positions of answer row; mean and p10/p50/p90
metric_definitions.sat_frac: fraction of pairs with max_j w_j > 0.99
metric_definitions.maxw_mean: mean over pairs of max_j w_j
metric_definitions.score_min_max_range: pre-softmax masked scores, finite entries only
metric_definitions.input_dep_std: max over j of std over the 9409 pairs of w_j
metric_definitions.interventions_one_variable_at_a_time: I1 pos->0 (transient copy); I2 inputs (b,a,'=') (acc_swap); I3 first operand -> 0 (descriptor); each reported beside matched baseline

decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h2a_saturation: seed0 entropy_mean at final below every grokked seed AND sat_frac > 0.5 while every grokked seed sat_frac < 0.1
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h2b_positional: seed0 input_dep_std < 1e-4 at final while every grokked seed > 1e-4; OR I1 |dAcc| > 0.5 for seed0 while every grokked seed < 0.1; OR I2 acc_swap < acc_base - 0.5 for seed0 while every grokked seed drops < 0.1
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h2_supported_engineering_level: H2a or H2b at final, directionally present at memorization
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h2_falsified: all seed0 metrics within seeds-1-4 span
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.no_post_hoc_thresholds: all thresholds fixed in this plan before execution
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.control_role: wd0-s0 final is a descriptor only, not in pass/fail logic

hypotheses.baseline_tie_in: before trusting any intervention, frozen grok.loss_acc must reproduce each snapshot's logged test accuracy to relative 1e-6 (diag06 precedent)
hypotheses.harness_liveness_control: I1 must change logits on at least one pair for every snapshot; bitwise identity aborts as harness defect
hypotheses.causality_caveat: entropy/saturation and intervention sensitivity are static-snapshot conditional associations; they cannot establish a necessary cause of past learning failure without dynamics; entropy alone never proves cause
hypotheses.allowed_conclusion: whether seed0's saved attention differs mechanistically (saturation/positional dependence/order sensitivity) from all grokked seeds at the same stages
hypotheses.not_supported_conclusion: causal claim that the pattern prevented grokking; claims about steps > 10000; eventual-grok or init-cause claims

execution_protocol.single_shot: scripts assert exclusive results namespace and refuse to overwrite anything including their own outputs
execution_protocol.stdout: one concise PASS/FAIL line per script; full values in JSON
